| M20cf | The ransom was the Traders' Spurn, which the thieves call the power to raise an army of undying soldiers. | *Duty, Honor, Country* · 2.0 · main | "The power to create an army of undying soldiers─''The Traders' Spurn''!" | #20c |

| M168a | The Mogglesguard entrusted Kuplo Kopp with the keystones to the king's wards. | *You Have Selected Regicide* · 2.1 · main | "Kuplo Kopp confided in me that he had been entrusted with a set of keystones by the Mogglesguard themselves." | #168 |

| M168c | With a heavy heart, Kuplo Kopp agrees to help you. | *You Have Selected Regicide* · 2.1 · main | "With a heavy heart, Kuplo Kopp consents to your plan, and bids you take the ferry to [[Sweetbloom Pier]]." | #168 |

| M168e | The king is slain and disintegrates into aether, leaving no corpse. | *You Have Selected Regicide* · 2.1 · main | "The loyal Mogglesguard can only watch in horror as their beloved king of legend disintegrates into aether, leaving behind no corpse." | #168 |
| M168f | All mooglekind owes you a debt. | *You Have Selected Regicide* · 2.1 · main | "All mooglekind owes you a debt, kupo!" | #168 |

| M169d | The king was called forth by a rite the Ascians gave the Mogglesguard. | *On the Properties of Primals* · 2.1 · main | "was called forth by means of a rite imparted to the Mogglesguard by the [[Ascian]]s." | #169 |
| M169e | The Elder Seedseer will send more supplies to Revenant's Toll. | *On the Properties of Primals* · 2.1 · main | "We shall be glad to send additional supplies to Revenant's Toll." | #169 |

| M170d | He calls himself an emissary, and says mastering the Echo could end the strife between the Ascians and the children of Hydaelyn. | *The Gifted* · 2.1 · main | "the trespasser proclaims himself an emissary, and speaks cryptically of the Echo and its power, asserting that mastery of this gift could end hostilities between the [[Ascians]] and the children of [[Hydaelyn]] forever." | #170 |
| M170e | He knows you as the one who bested Lahabrea in the Praetorium. | *The Gifted* · 2.1 · main | "Although he recognizes you as the one who bested [[Lahabrea]] in [[the Praetorium]]," | #170 |

| M170g | He says Hydaelyn's influence is waning. | *The Gifted* · 2.1 · main | "Her influence wanes, and Her strength shall soon be spent." | #170 |

| M170i | Minfilia has Urianger ask the Students of Baldesion to search their archives. | *The Gifted* · 2.1 · main | "Urianger, send word to the Students of Baldesion. Tell them to scour the archives─the forbidden tomes in particular." | #170 |
| M170j | Elidibus says that, unlike the Ascian before him, he has no quarrel with Minfilia. | *The Gifted* · 2.1 · main | "Mine are the robes of an emissary. Unlike he who came before, I have no quarrel with you." | #170 |

| M171b | His journal holds everything his agents could steal about the primals. | *Build on the Stone* · 2.1 · main | "It contains every shred of information he and his agents could steal on what they believed to be the single greatest threat to Eorzea: the primals." | #171 |

| M172b | Minfilia fears the thief may serve a primal. | *Still Waters* · 2.2 · main | "If there is even a possibility that the thief acts not out of self-interest but in service to a primal, we can ill afford to wait for the Blades to realize their mistake." | #172 |

| M173e | Thancred is placed in charge of matters in Thanalan. | *A Final Temptation* · 2.2 · main | "Having been placed in charge of matters in [[Thanalan]], Thancred invites you to return with him to [[Horizon]] and report to Fufulupa." | #173 |

| M174g | The sultana, Raubahn and Teledji sympathize with Yugiri's cause. | *The Mother of Exiles* · 2.2 · main | "Although the sultana, Raubahn, and [[Teledji Adeledji]] are sympathetic to her cause, the most influential member of the Syndicate" | #174 |

| M177d | Two Doman children resolve to found a Doman Adventurers' Guild in Revenant's Toll. | *Why We Adventure* · 2.2 · main | "the two children resolve there and then to form a [[Doman Adventurers' Guild]] once they reach [[Revenant's Toll]]." | #177 |

| M178d | The Sahagin are preparing to summon Leviathan again, and Admiral Merlwyb asks the Scions' aid. | *All Due Respect* · 2.2 · main | "All evidence suggests that the [[Sahagin]] are preparing to summon [[Leviathan]] once more, and Admiral [[Merlwyb]] has petitioned the [[Scions]]' aid in preventing the [[primal]]'s return." | #178 |

| M178f | Minfilia joins the mission to learn the true nature of the Echo. | *All Due Respect* · 2.2 · main | "Desiring to learn the true nature of [[the Echo]], Minfilia declares her intent to join you on this mission." | #178 |

| M179b | The Sahagin lacked the crystals to summon their god until the Serpent Reavers brought more from Thanalan. | *The Sea Rises* · 2.2 · main | "According to our best intelligence, the Sahagin had not crystals enough to summon their god. … Alas, we did not count on the Serpent Reavers venturing as far as Thanalan to supplement their cache." | #179 |
| M179c | The Admiral has sent Maelstrom scouts into the Sapsa Spawning Grounds. | *The Sea Rises* · 2.2 · main | "In the command room, the Admiral informs you that [[Maelstrom]] scouts have been dispatched to reconnoiter [[Sahagin]] movement within the [[Sapsa Spawning Grounds]]." | #179 |
| M179d | The Maelstrom readies an operation to stop the summoning and wants the Scions' support. | *The Sea Rises* · 2.2 · main | "Even as we speak, the Maelstrom makes ready to launch a large-scale operation to thwart the summoning, and we would welcome the Scions' support in this endeavor." | #179 |
| M179e | Minfilia goes to the front because there is something she would see with her own eyes. | *The Sea Rises* · 2.2 · main | "I will say only that there is something I would see with mine own eyes." | #179 |
| M180a | Serpent Reavers ambushed the Maelstrom's scouts. | *Scouts in Distress* · 2.2 · main | "We were ambushed by the Serpent Reavers. Lightly armed as we are, we didn't stand a chance." | #180 |

| M180c | At a dear price, the Maelstrom has its intelligence, and the operation may begin. | *Scouts in Distress* · 2.2 · main | "Though the price was dear, [[the Maelstrom]] now has the intelligence it sought, and the operation may commence." | #180 |
| M181a | The aim is to take the Sapsa aetheryte and kill the priest leading the summoning. | *The Gift of Eternity* · 2.2 · main | "Remember: our ultimate objective is to take the Sapsa aetheryte and eliminate the Sahagin priest presiding over the summoning─we are not here to kill them all." | #181 |
| M181b | Minfilia senses the Echo as the Sahagin priest offers himself to Leviathan. | *The Gift of Eternity* · 2.2 · main | "I know this sensation... It's the Echo!" | #181 |
| M181c | The dying priest curses the Emissary who promised him everlasting life. | *The Gift of Eternity* · 2.2 · main | "Curse you, Emissary! You promised me...everlasssting..." | #181 |
| M181d | Leviathan rises and destroys the diversionary squadron. | *The Gift of Eternity* · 2.2 · main | "Leviathan wastes no time. The diversionary squadron is lost." | #181 |
| M181e | Merlwyb fears a tidal wave that could raze coastal settlements. | *The Gift of Eternity* · 2.2 · main | "Enough to raze entire coastal settlements, if his last attempt is any guide." | #181 |
| M181f | The Sahagin have made thralls of soldiers and civilians. | *The Gift of Eternity* · 2.2 · main | "Damn them... They have made thralls of soldiers and civilians both..." | #181 |
| M182a | After the Calamity, Leviathan's tidal wave leveled Halfstone. | *Into the Heart of the Whorl* · 2.2 · main | "he summoned a tidal wave which fair leveled Halfstone, and washed the soil away for good measure." | #182 |

| M182c | The Company of Heroes beat Leviathan by luring him into an inlet; now he must be fought on the open sea. | *Into the Heart of the Whorl* · 2.2 · main | "The Company of Heroes defeated Leviathan having first lured him into an inlet, but we must needs contend with him upon the open sea." | #182 |
| M182d | A Storm Marshal's device would draw on corrupted crystals. | *Into the Heart of the Whorl* · 2.2 · main | "They draw upon the power of corrupted crystals, I am told." | #182 |

| M182f | The twin vessel is complete. | *Into the Heart of the Whorl* · 2.2 · main | "At any rate, I have tidings for you: the twin vessel is now complete." | #182 |
| M183a | The Whorleater's corrupted crystals should rob Leviathan of his hold over water. | *Lord of the Whorl* · 2.2 · main | "Assuming the thing works, it will use the power of the corrupted crystals on board to rob Leviathan of his hold over water." | #183 |
| M183b | Leviathan calls you tainted of the Light. | *Lord of the Whorl* · 2.2 · main | "You trespass upon my domain, tainted of the Light!" | #183 |
| M183c | You vanquish Leviathan on the high seas. | *Lord of the Whorl* · 2.2 · main | "Following a titanic struggle on the high seas, you succeed in vanquishing Leviathan." | #183 |
| M183d | Thancred knows of a secret fraternity in Limsa Lominsa. | *Lord of the Whorl* · 2.2 · main | "Few are privy to this information, but Limsa Lominsa is home to a certain...secret fraternity." | #183 |
| M183e | Merlwyb pledges provisions to the Domans. | *Lord of the Whorl* · 2.2 · main | "Yet I'll not have it said that we turned a blind eye to your suffering. Until such time as we can do more, I pledge to send provisions." | #183 |
| M183f | A chance meeting with Alphinaud's grandsire took Thancred from Limsa Lominsa, and he trained in the blade in Ul'dah. | *Lord of the Whorl* · 2.2 · main | "But for a chance encounter with Alphinaud's grandsire, he might never have left Limsa Lominsa; … or taken up his post in Ul'dah─which is where he trained in the blade, lest you wonder." | #183 |
| M183g | Merlwyb grants Y'shtola that man bears part of the blame for the primals. | *Lord of the Whorl* · 2.2 · main | "I have not forgotten our conversation, Y'shtola. I am aware that man bears part of the blame for the primals' existence." | #183 |
| M183h | Merlwyb holds that when coexistence fails, strength decides. | *Lord of the Whorl* · 2.2 · main | "When hopes of coexistence founder, strength must determine who has the greater right to live." | #183 |
| M184a | A letter from Merlwyb gains Yugiri entry to the Lominsan underworld. | *When Yugiri Met the Fraternity* · 2.2 · main | "Zanthael gives you a [[Merlwyb's Letter of Introduction|letter of introduction from Merlwyb]], which should grant [[Yugiri]] access to the Lominsan underworld." | #184 |
| M184b | Yugiri of Doma finds kinship in the fraternity's art of stealth. | *When Yugiri Met the Fraternity* · 2.2 · main | "I am Yugiri of Doma. … 'Tis in stealth that our strength lies. There is much we might learn from one another, I think." | #184 |
| M184c | Yugiri hopes to teach her martial art to the people of Eorzea. | *When Yugiri Met the Fraternity* · 2.2 · main | "Ere long, I hope to begin imparting my martial knowledge to the people of Eorzea." | #184 |
| M184d | The fraternity's gatekeeper knows Thancred of old. | *When Yugiri Met the Fraternity* · 2.2 · main | "I was hopin' I might catch a glimpse of Thancred, too─been a while since I saw his shite-eatin' grin." | #184 |
| M185a | The slain Sahagin elder's spirit left his body, a consciousness without form. | *Through the Maelstrom* · 2.2 · main | "When the Admiral subsequently slew him, his spirit emerged from his lifeless flesh, a consciousness shorn of physical form." | #185 |
| M185b | He was then absorbed into Leviathan. | *Through the Maelstrom* · 2.2 · main | "As we both bore witness, he was ultimately absorbed into Leviathan." | #185 |
| M185c | Minfilia reasons that the Ascians, existing the same way, can be destroyed. | *Through the Maelstrom* · 2.2 · main | "If the Ascians' mode of existence is indeed the same, it can be inferred that they, too, are not invulnerable─that they ''can'' be destroyed." | #185 |
| M185d | A legend tells of souls reborn at each Umbral Calamity to stay the Darkness. | *Through the Maelstrom* · 2.2 · main | "There exists a legend which tells of souls who are reborn upon the cusp of each Umbral Calamity, that they might stay the encroaching Darkness." | #185 |
| M185e | Elidibus spoke of an existence without end. | *Through the Maelstrom* · 2.2 · main | "It was of this that Elidibus spoke─an existence which knows neither cessation nor oblivion." | #185 |
| M185f | The Isle of Val, home of the Students of Baldesion, is no more. | *Through the Maelstrom* · 2.2 · main | "My lady...the Isle of Val, which for many years hath been the order's home, is no more." | #185 |
| M185g | A magick like Ultima is thought to have been used. | *Through the Maelstrom* · 2.2 · main | "'Tis postulated that a magick was evoked, like in power to Ultima." | #185 |
| M185h | Teledji's servant does not understand the orders he is given. | *Through the Maelstrom* · 2.2 · main | "F-Forgive my impertinence, my lord, but these orders... I am uncertain as to what end they serve." | #185 |
| M186a | A great aetheric disturbance in the Twelveswood may mean a primal. | *The Great Divide* · 2.3 · main | "Yet all is not well in the Twelveswood. Our latest readings reveal an ongoing aetheric disturbance of considerable magnitude. They may even suggest the presence of a primal." | #186 |
| M186b | Refugees from Ul'dah come to Revenant's Toll seeking asylum. | *The Great Divide* · 2.3 · main | "refugees hailing from [[Ul'dah]] have come to [[Revenant's Toll]] in search of asylum, like the [[Doma]]ns before them." | #186 |
| M186c | Minfilia denies the refugees' request. | *The Great Divide* · 2.3 · main | "And so it is with great regret that I must deny your request." | #186 |
| M186d | Alphinaud is injured in a riot begun by refugees in Ul'dah. | *The Great Divide* · 2.3 · main | "that [[Alphinaud]] was injured during a riot precipitated by refugees in Ul'dah" | #186 |
| M186e | Much of the Immortal Flames is away on joint exercises. | *The Great Divide* · 2.3 · main | "a large contingent of [[the Immortal Flames]] is currently engaged in joint training exercises, rendering the [[Grand Company]] undermanned at this critical juncture." | #186 |
| M186f | The riot grew from tensions between refugees and citizens after the Domans' failed bid for asylum. | *The Great Divide* · 2.3 · main | "The riot, it seems, was the result of deep-seated tensions between refugees and Ul'dahn citizens, brought to the fore in the wake of the Domans' failed bid for asylum." | #186 |
| M186g | Alphinaud is not badly hurt. | *The Great Divide* · 2.3 · main | "Alphinaud's condition is not so grave as you were given to believe." | #186 |
| M187a | Alphinaud suspects the riot was not spontaneous. | *Desperate Times* · 2.3 · main | "Nevertheless, I have reason to believe that this particular riot may not have begun spontaneously." | #187 |
| M187b | Raubahn secured the city, but unrest has spread through Thanalan. | *Desperate Times* · 2.3 · main | "We secured the city soon enough, but not before the unrest had spread to the surrounding territories." | #187 |
| M187c | Several rioting refugees carried martial weapons. | *Desperate Times* · 2.3 · main | "I observed that several of the refugees were armed─and not with butcher's knives or pitchforks, but with martial weaponry." | #187 |
| M187d | Raubahn puts restoring order before any investigation. | *Desperate Times* · 2.3 · main | "That is my first duty. Until it is done, any investigation can wait." | #187 |
| M187e | A merchant recruited refugees at Lost Hope to hold Ul'dah's rulers to account. | *Desperate Times* · 2.3 · main | "Apparently, he offered the refugees a chance to hold the rulers of [[Ul'dah]] to account, and attracted no shortage of volunteers." | #187 |
| M187f | He armed them and split them into two groups. | *Desperate Times* · 2.3 · main | "the merchant furnished his fellows with weapons so that they might defend themselves against Ul'dahn forces, and then split them into two groups." | #187 |
| M187g | An Immortal Flames patrol cut down one group. | *Desperate Times* · 2.3 · main | "Unfortunately for them, the survivor's group encountered an Immortal Flames patrol, who swiftly gave the refugees cause to rue their lack of training" | #187 |
| M187h | The other group is still out there. | *Desperate Times* · 2.3 · main | "Oh gods, the other group! They're still out there! If we don't stop them, they'll be massacred like mine was!" | #187 |
| M188a | You defeat the group's sellsword leaders before them all. | *Shock and Awe* · 2.3 · main | "challenge their leaders, twin sellswords, to combat and defeat them as all watch." | #188 |
| M188b | Their defeat ends the fight. | *Shock and Awe* · 2.3 · main | "Fortunately, their defeat seems to have had the desired effect." | #188 |
| M188c | The merchant will keep recruiting desperate refugees. | *Shock and Awe* · 2.3 · main | "the merchant will attempt to recruit more desperate refugees, perpetuating the bloodshed" | #188 |
| M188d | A shadowy figure is sowing dissent. | *Shock and Awe* · 2.3 · main | "Who is this shadowy figure intent on sowing dissent?" | #188 |
| M189a | The merchant meant to recruit in Stonesthrow. | *Reap the Whirlwind* · 2.3 · main | "Recalling that the merchant wished to approach the people of [[Stonesthrow]], the survivor bids you continue your search there." | #189 |
| M189b | A girl's parents left with the merchant, who promised they could live inside the walls. | *Reap the Whirlwind* · 2.3 · main | "The man said they were gonna change everything─make it so we could live inside the walls with everyone else." | #189 |
| M189c | Cornered, the merchant offers to tell all if you protect him. | *Reap the Whirlwind* · 2.3 · main | "We both know I am not the one you want. However, if you agree to protect me, I swear I shall tell you everything." | #189 |
| M189d | An unseen archer kills the merchant. | *Reap the Whirlwind* · 2.3 · main | "The merchant is shot and killed by an arrow from an unknown sniper." | #189 |
| M189e | He was silenced before he could talk. | *Reap the Whirlwind* · 2.3 · main | "he was ''silenced''. Too many knew his face, and he was ready to divulge his secrets." | #189 |
| M189f | The true orchestrator of the riots may soon be found. | *Reap the Whirlwind* · 2.3 · main | "We may be closer to identifying the true orchestrator of these riots than you realize." | #189 |
| M190a | Raubahn summons you to a private meeting in the Fragrant Chamber. | *Revolution* · 2.3 · main | "General Raubahn has summoned you to a private meeting in [[the Fragrant Chamber]]" | #190 |
| M190b | Brass Blades loosed arrows on unarmed protesters. | *Revolution* · 2.3 · main | "A unit of Brass Blades sent to supervise a demonstration loosed arrows upon unarmed protesters." | #190 |
| M190c | Their commander was paid to give the order by a merchant in Teledji's employ. | *Revolution* · 2.3 · main | "The dog confessed that a merchant had offered him coin to give the order─a merchant in the employ of Teledji Adeledji." | #190 |
| M190d | Teledji orchestrated the refugee uprising from the start. | *Revolution* · 2.3 · main | "[[Teledji Adeledji]] is one such man, having orchestrated the refugee uprising from the start." | #190 |
| M190e | A bill would annex the Carteneau Flats for refugee settlements. | *Revolution* · 2.3 · main | "It is a proposal to annex the Carteneau Flats so that refugees may establish permanent settlements." | #190 |
| M190f | An Allagan weapon lies in the Flats, said to have been made to fell Bahamut. | *Revolution* · 2.3 · main | "Allagan inscriptions indicate that it was created to fell Bahamut himself." | #190 |
| M190g | Omega has long since ceased to function. | *Revolution* · 2.3 · main | "At present, Omega is more akin to a fossil than a tool of war, having long since ceased to function." | #190 |
| M190h | Raubahn believes Teledji wants Omega's power to subjugate Ul'dah and Eorzea. | *Revolution* · 2.3 · main | "Power enough to subjugate Ul'dah, like as not, and the rest of Eorzea besides─which is doubtless why Teledji Adeledji yearns to have it." | #190 |
| M190i | Your allies are not yet ready to move against Teledji. | *Revolution* · 2.3 · main | "Yet despite having learned of Teledji Adeledji's schemes, it would seem that your allies are not yet ready to move against him" | #190 |
| M191a | Alphinaud wonders how long the Scions would have been kept from knowing of Omega. | *Stories We Tell* · 2.3 · main | "How long do you think they intended to hide the existence of Omega from the Scions?" | #191 |
| M191b | Alphinaud is sickened that one man's lust for power caused the chaos. | *Stories We Tell* · 2.3 · main | "the thought that all this chaos was the product of one man's lust for power sickens me." | #191 |
| M191c | Alphinaud offers to help the girl search for her parents. | *Stories We Tell* · 2.3 · main | "Although he clearly has no desire to do so, Alphinaud offers to assist the girl with her search." | #191 |
| M191d | Alphinaud fears Minfilia is too ambitious. | *Stories We Tell* · 2.3 · main | "Sometimes I fear Minfilia is too ambitious." | #191 |
| M191e | Minfilia calls you back: the Twelveswood has taken a turn for the worse. | *Stories We Tell* · 2.3 · main | "The situation in the Twelveswood has taken a turn for the worse." | #191 |
| M192a | The Twin Adder believes the sylphs have summoned their guardian, the primal Ramuh. | *Lord of Levin* · 2.3 · main | "They have reason to believe that the sylphs may have called forth their revered guardian─the primal Ramuh." | #192 |
| M192b | The elementals murmur of Ramuh's return to the forest. | *Lord of Levin* · 2.3 · main | "The Elder Seedseer informs us that the elementals themselves murmur of the Lord of Levin's return to the forest." | #192 |
| M192c | Yda expected the summoning, just not so soon. | *Lord of Levin* · 2.3 · main | "Oh, it didn't. I was pretty sure it was going to happen─just not this soon." | #192 |
| M192d | Papalymo thinks the refugee influx alarmed the sylphs into hastening the summoning. | *Lord of Levin* · 2.3 · main | "'Tis like that the sylphs perceived this panicked migration as yet another invasion, and quickened their efforts to summon their god." | #192 |
| M192e | The sylphs first summoned Ramuh after the Calamity, when the Garleans came through the forest. | *Lord of Levin* · 2.3 · main | "They already summoned Ramuh once right after the Calamity, but that was because the Garleans came tramping through the forest..." | #192 |
| M192f | The Elder Seedseer asks you to represent Gridania in a negotiation with Ramuh. | *Lord of Levin* · 2.3 · main | "I would ask therefore that you represent us in this most delicate of negotiations." | #192 |
| M192g | Ramuh is no raging avatar of destruction. | *Lord of Levin* · 2.3 · main | "Unlike the other primals you have encountered, Lord Ramuh is no raging avatar of destruction." | #192 |
| M192h | Minfilia warns the meeting may not be amicable. | *Lord of Levin* · 2.3 · main | "Steel yourself for the worst. While I hope for a peaceful resolution to this matter, experience suggests that your meeting with the Lord of Levin will prove less than amicable." | #192 |
| M193a | Ramuh says the sylphs turned to him for succor, and pronounces sentence on humankind. | *Levin an Impression* · 2.3 · main | "Thus did they turn to me for succor. The sentence I pronounce upon thy kind is just." | #193 |
| M193b | Ramuh sees something more in you than the Bringer of Light. | *Levin an Impression* · 2.3 · main | "Thou standest apart from thy kin. Thou art the Bringer of Light, aye...but there is something more in thee..." | #193 |
| M193c | You defeat Ramuh and earn the right to champion peace in the Black Shroud. | *Levin an Impression* · 2.3 · main | "You have defeated the Lord of Levin, and thus earned the right to champion the cause of peace in [[the Black Shroud]]." | #193 |
| M193d | Ramuh judges you a worthy champion and charges you with excising the sin in man's heart. | *Levin an Impression* · 2.3 · main | "And I judge thee a worthy champion. The task of excising the sin that hath taken root in man's heart is thine." | #193 |
| M193e | Urianger glimpses a possible chink in the Ascians' armor. | *Levin an Impression* · 2.3 · main | "If I mistake not, it may yet prove a chink in the eternal armor of the Ascians." | #193 |
| M193f | A sylph guide fears the fate of his tempered brethren. | *Levin an Impression* · 2.3 · main | "for fear of suffering the same fate as his tempered brethren." | #193 |
| M194a | The Elder Seedseer sees the Alliance straining under self-interest. | *What Little Gods Are Made Of* · 2.3 · main | "Our shared struggle against the Empire should have served to seal our union, yet the ties which bind the Alliance strain under the weight of gross self-interest." | #194 |
| M194b | Urianger names the white-clad Ascian as Elidibus. | *What Little Gods Are Made Of* · 2.3 · main | "I speak of the Ascian clad in white, Elidibus." | #194 |
| M194c | To the Ascians, physical destruction is only a temporary inconvenience. | *What Little Gods Are Made Of* · 2.3 · main | "that the Ascians are eternal beings, to whom physical destruction is as a temporary inconvenience." | #194 |
| M194d | The ascended Sahagin had no Crystal of Darkness to flee by, so Leviathan consumed him. | *What Little Gods Are Made Of* · 2.3 · main | "The Sahagin ascended to an immortal state, but he did not possess a Crystal of Darkness through which to flee this realm. Thus was he consumed by Leviathan." | #194 |
| M194e | A Crystal of Darkness, used to control Thancred, may be a gateway to that place. | *What Little Gods Are Made Of* · 2.3 · main | "The Ascians took control of Thancred by means of a Crystal of Darkness─an artifact which, if our theories are correct, serves as a gateway to the place I have just described." | #194 |
| M194f | The Scions lack a way to trap and destroy an Ascian soul. | *What Little Gods Are Made Of* · 2.3 · main | "At present, we lack a viable means to entrap and extinguish an Ascian soul." | #194 |

| M194j | A Sharlayan survey party seeks the fate of the Students of Baldesion. | *What Little Gods Are Made Of* · 2.3 · main | "Even now, a Sharlayan survey party seeketh to ascertain the fate of the Students of Baldesion." | #194 |
| M195a | A letter thanks the Scions for quelling the primal threat. | *Guardian of Eorzea* · 2.3 · main | "Minfilia informs you that a letter has arrived expressing gratitude for [[the Scions]]' efforts in quelling the [[primal]] threat." | #195 |

| M195c | Minfilia expects the Ascians to sow chaos until they are stopped. | *Guardian of Eorzea* · 2.3 · main | "The Ascians may be relied upon to sow chaos in this realm until such time as they are forced to stop." | #195 |
| M195d | Alphinaud wants a new organization that works beyond nations and borders. | *Guardian of Eorzea* · 2.3 · main | "is a new, expanded organization that operates beyond the limitations of nations and borders." | #195 |
| M195e | Alphinaud sought to understand why his grandfather gave his life. | *Guardian of Eorzea* · 2.3 · main | "I sought to grasp the reason why Grandfather willingly sacrificed himself to protect it." | #195 |
| M195f | Alphinaud vows to take up the mantle of guardian of Eorzea. | *Guardian of Eorzea* · 2.3 · main | "I, too, will endeavor to take up the mantle of guardian of Eorzea, and champion these people who toil towards a better world." | #195 |
| M196a | Alphinaud plans a realm-wide Grand Company. | *Recruiting the Realm* · 2.3 · main | "Alphinaud lays before you the plan to establish a realm-wide [[Grand Company]]." | #196 |

| M196e | Under Ul'dahn law there is no evidence to convict Teledji. | *Recruiting the Realm* · 2.3 · main | "as Ul'dahn law now stands, we lack the evidence to convict him of any crime." | #196 |

| M196h | Laurentius, whose crimes you exposed, joins. | *Recruiting the Realm* · 2.3 · main | "It is I, Laurentius, the man whose crimes you exposed." | #196 |
| M197a | The trial company's arrival strains Slafborn and Revenant's Toll. | *Heretical Harassment* · 2.3 · main | "Minfilia expresses concern that the bustling chaos surrounding the official commencement of [[Alphinaud]]'s trial company has placed undue stress on [[Slafborn]] and his efforts to supervise the growing population of Revenant's Toll." | #197 |
| M197b | Coerthan heretics robbed a supply shipment near the Mor Dhona border. | *Heretical Harassment* · 2.3 · main | "a band of [[Coerthas|Coerthan]] heretics near the border to [[Mor Dhona]]." | #197 |
| M197c | Slafborn says heretics make it more than theft; Ishgard must be told. | *Heretical Harassment* · 2.3 · main | "If heretics are involved, then this is like to be more than a case of simple thievery. Ishgard will need to be informed." | #197 |
| M197d | You go to Coerthas to help House Fortemps track the stolen shipment. | *Heretical Harassment* · 2.3 · main | "Slafborn asks that you travel to Coerthas and aid [[House Fortemps]] in tracking down the stolen shipment meant for the frontier hands of Revenant's Toll." | #197 |
| M197e | Haurchefant was about to open an urgent missive from Revenant's Toll. | *Heretical Harassment* · 2.3 · main | "I was, in fact, on the verge of opening an urgent missive from Revenant's Toll, and I suspect the timing of your arrival is no coincidence..." | #197 |
| M198a | Haurchefant sends you to Lord Drillemont at Whitebrim. | *When the Cold Sets In* · 2.3 · main | "Reasoning that your best chance to track down the supply thieves lies in [[Whitebrim]] and its heretic-infested environs, the garrison commander suggests you bring the matter before Lord [[Drillemont]]." | #198 |
| M198b | The heretics' new unity is credited to their leader, the Lady Iceheart. | *When the Cold Sets In* · 2.3 · main | "This new unity of purpose we attribute to their leader─the Lady “Iceheart.”" | #198 |
| M198c | No one knows Iceheart's birthname. | *When the Cold Sets In* · 2.3 · main | "we have yet to learn so much as her birthname." | #198 |
| M198d | The heretics revere Iceheart and would die rather than betray her. | *When the Cold Sets In* · 2.3 · main | "the heretics speak of Iceheart in reverent tones, and would gladly embrace death rather than betray her." | #198 |
| M198e | Drillemont finds the heretics somehow changed. | *When the Cold Sets In* · 2.3 · main | "But 'tis not merely their newfound organization that confounds us: the heretics themselves seem somehow ''changed''." | #198 |
| M198f | The heretics spoke of returning to Snowcloak. | *When the Cold Sets In* · 2.3 · main | "Before darkness claimed me, however, I distinctly heard the words, “return to Snowcloak.”" | #198 |
| M198g | A knight glimpses a woman on the cliff who may be Iceheart. | *When the Cold Sets In* · 2.3 · main | "Could it be Iceheart herself come to sneer at our folly!?" | #198 |
| M198h | Haurchefant hands the matter to the Temple Knights. | *When the Cold Sets In* · 2.3 · main | "I am bound by duty to inform the Temple Knights and request that they bring this matter to its conclusion." | #198 |
| M198i | Haurchefant sends a second shipment to Revenant's Toll. | *When the Cold Sets In* · 2.3 · main | "I have already made arrangements for a second shipment to be sent to Revenant's Toll." | #198 |
| M199a | Tataru is buried in the ceremony's small details. | *Brave New Companions* · 2.3 · main | "He is concerned, however, that [[Tataru]] yet seems buried under a mountain of small details." | #199 |
| M199b | Ilberd will lead the recruits as captain. | *Brave New Companions* · 2.3 · main | "I don't believe we've met. I am Ilberd, and I will have the honor of leading my fellow recruits as captain." | #199 |
| M199c | Alphinaud declares the recruits Crystal Braves. | *Brave New Companions* · 2.3 · main | "From this moment forth, I declare you Crystal Braves!" | #199 |
| M199d | Hydaelyn has spoken to neither you nor Minfilia since the final battle with the Empire. | *Brave New Companions* · 2.3 · main | "the Antecedent realizes that [[Hydaelyn]] has spoken to neither of you since the final battle with [[Garlean Empire|the Empire]]." | #199 |
| M199e | Minfilia's friend Krile survived the loss of the Isle of Val, though she has not woken. | *Brave New Companions* · 2.3 · main | "Truly!? Krile is alive!? | M199f | The isle's destruction came close to Ultima's magnitude; Minfilia wonders if the Ascians are to blame. | *Brave New Companions* · 2.3 · main | "It appears the aetheric disturbance which accompanied the isle's destruction is of a magnitude alarmingly close to that of Ultima. | M199g | Archbishop Thordan holds a ceremony with the Temple Knights, with Lahabrea and Elidibus behind him. | *Brave New Companions* · 2.3 · main | "The scene shifts to [[Archbishop Thordan VII]] conducting a ceremony with the Temple Knights. | M199h | Minfilia prays that Louisoix still watches over them. | *Brave New Companions* · 2.3 · main | "Louisoix... I pray you yet watch over us..." | #199 |
| M200a | Minfilia asks you to help Alphinaud run the newly formed Crystal Braves. | *Traitor in the Midst* · 2.4 · main | "Conscious of the many practical difficulties facing the newly formed Crystal Braves, Minfilia asks that you place yourself at Alphinaud's disposal." | #200 |
| M200b | Ilberd reveals that a Garlean spy known as the Ivy has infiltrated one of the Grand Companies. | *Traitor in the Midst* · 2.4 · main | "Ilberd reveals that a [[Garlean]] spy known as [[the Ivy]] has infiltrated one of the [[Grand Companies]]." | #200 |
| M200c | A suspect in the Immortal Flames proved to be only one of the many in the spy's employ. | *Traitor in the Midst* · 2.4 · main | "A suspect was identified among [[the Immortal Flames]], but the man proved to be but one of many in the agent's employ." | #200 |
| M200d | The Ivy's conspirators are the vines by which the spy learns secrets without being exposed. | *Traitor in the Midst* · 2.4 · main | "These conspirators are the vines by which he learns our secrets, all without exposing himself." | #200 |
| M200e | Raubahn and Ilberd have been friends and rivals since before the fall of Ala Mhigo. | *Traitor in the Midst* · 2.4 · main | "You learn that Raubahn and Ilberd have been friends and rivals since before the fall of [[Ala Mhigo]]." | #200 |
| M200f | Raubahn is a Flame General. | *Traitor in the Midst* · 2.4 · main | "Flame General... You wear the mantle well, old friend." | #200 |
| M200g | Raubahn wonders whether the Monetarists have been in league with the Empire from the first. | *Traitor in the Midst* · 2.4 · main | "Could it be that the Monetarists have been in league with the Empire from the first?" | #200 |
| M200h | Ilberd fears the Empire will soon resume its march on Eorzea. | *Traitor in the Midst* · 2.4 · main | "Garlemald's war of succession nears its end, and it is feared that the Empire will soon resume its march on Eorzea." | #200 |

| M220a | Yuyuhase blames Riol's intelligence. | *Best-Laid Schemes* · 2.5 · main | "Clearly, Riol is unfamiliar with the ways of Ul'dahn merchants, who ever strive to present themselves as greater than they are." | #220 |
| M220b | Riol insists his information was reliable. | *Best-Laid Schemes* · 2.5 · main | "Our information was reliable, godsdammit! I ''know'' he purchased those weapons!" | #220 |
| M220c | Riol notes the 1st and 3rd Units now spend freely. | *Best-Laid Schemes* · 2.5 · main | "'Course these days the money flows like water, an' the 1st an' 3rd get the shiniest new toys..." | #220 |
| M220d | A guest from Ishgard asks to see you. | *Best-Laid Schemes* · 2.5 · main | "a guest from [[Ishgard]] has requested your presence." | #220 |
| M221a | Lucia comes on Aymeric's behalf to ask your help. | *The Rising Chorus* · 2.5 · main | "Waiting for you in the solar is [[Lucia]], Ser [[Aymeric]]'s second-in-command, who has come on his behalf to request your assistance with a matter of grave import." | #221 |
| M221b | The Observatorium's astrologians read the signs as Midgardsormr's imminent resurrection. | *The Rising Chorus* · 2.5 · main | "The [[astrologian]]s of [[the Observatorium]] have interpreted recent signs as an indication of [[Midgardsormr]]'s imminent resurrection." | #221 |
| M221c | The explosion that followed Eorzea's victory claimed the great wyrm's life. | *The Rising Chorus* · 2.5 · main | "Yet this victory came at a great cost, for the explosion which followed claimed the life of the great wyrm as well." | #221 |
| M221d | Atop the wreck of the Agrius you confront the fallen guardian of Silvertear Falls. | *The Rising Chorus* · 2.5 · main | "atop the wreckage of the ''Agrius'' you confront the fallen guardian of [[Silvertear Falls]]" | #221 |
| M221e | Hydaelyn marks you as Her chosen, and Midgardsormr strips you of the Mothercrystal's blessing. | *The Rising Chorus* · 2.5 · main | "only to hesitate when [[Hydaelyn]] intervenes and marks you as one of Her chosen. Midgardsormr then relents─but not before somehow stripping you of [[the Mothercrystal]]'s blessing." | #221 |
| M221f | A covenant binds Midgardsormr to you. | *The Rising Chorus* · 2.5 · main | "Revealing that a covenant binds him to you" | #221 |
| M221g | Midgardsormr says his children now sing of Ishgard's destruction. | *The Rising Chorus* · 2.5 · main | "the wyrm lord flatly states that his children now sing of Ishgard's imminent destruction" | #221 |
| M221h | The Scions keep most of the conversation with Midgardsormr secret. | *The Rising Chorus* · 2.5 · main | "it would be best to keep the majority of your conversation with Midgardsormr a secret" | #221 |
| M221i | Lucia thanks you for confirming that a Dravanian attack is coming. | *The Rising Chorus* · 2.5 · main | "for bringing confirmation of the impending [[Dravanian]] attack" | #221 |
| M221j | Until Ishgard asks for aid, the Scions can only watch and wait. | *The Rising Chorus* · 2.5 · main | "Until such time as they choose to request aid, you and the others have no choice but to watch and wait." | #221 |
| M222a | An Ascian is immortal because its soul does not return to the aetherial realm when its host falls. | *Aether on Demand* · 2.5 · main | "An Ascian is an immortal because its soul doesn't return to the aetherial realm when its host is defeated." | #222 |
| M222b | Moenbryda plans to siphon energy from corrupted crystals across Eorzea. | *Aether on Demand* · 2.5 · main | "by siphoning energy from the corrupted crystals found across [[Eorzea]]." | #222 |
| M222c | The XIVth Legion lost the Empire's support, but was replenished from Castrum Centri. | *Aether on Demand* · 2.5 · main | "Having lost the Empire's support, the XIVth Legion lacks the resources to sustain itself. … Not long after our forces withdrew, however, their ranks were replenished by reinforcements from Castrum Centri." | #222 |
| M222d | Minfilia sends Alphinaud, with Thancred and Papalymo, to support the Crystal Braves. | *Aether on Demand* · 2.5 · main | "Pray join the Crystal Braves and lend them your support. Thancred and Papalymo shall accompany you." | #222 |

| M223b | Ilberd marches the 3rd Unit out of Ul'dah to the plant. | *On the Counteroffensive* · 2.5 · main | "The 3rd was getting restless holed up in Ul'dah, so I marched them out here to fill any holes in the plant's defenses and add their numbers to your counterattack." | #223 |
| M223c | The plant is no longer in immediate danger. | *On the Counteroffensive* · 2.5 · main | "The Amajina engineers will be most relieved to hear that the plant is no longer in any immediate danger." | #223 |

| M224c | The staff Nabriales seeks is Tupsimati, the relic Louisoix once wielded. | *An Uninvited Ascian* · 2.5 · main | "Moenbryda realizes that the staff Nabriales spoke of is likely [[Tupsimati]], the relic once wielded by [[Louisoix]] himself." | #224 |
| M224d | Nabriales escapes through a rift with Minfilia and the relic. | *An Uninvited Ascian* · 2.5 · main | "He then tears open a dimensional rift, through which he escapes with both Minfilia and the relic she holds." | #224 |
| M224e | Minfilia realizes the Isle of Val and the scholars' fate were Nabriales's doing. | *An Uninvited Ascian* · 2.5 · main | "Then it was ''your'' doing! The Isle of Val, the scholars─all of it!" | #224 |
| M224f | You defeat Nabriales and rescue Minfilia. | *An Uninvited Ascian* · 2.5 · main | "You have defeated Nabriales and rescued Minfilia." | #224 |
| M224g | Minfilia traps the weakened Ascian's soul in white auracite. | *An Uninvited Ascian* · 2.5 · main | "Minfilia succeeds in trapping the soul of the weakened Ascian within the chunk of [[White Auracite|white auracite]]." | #224 |
| M224h | Moenbryda spends her own life energy so your blade can pierce Nabriales. | *An Uninvited Ascian* · 2.5 · main | "The wounded scholar then expends her own life energy in a brilliant burst of aether, allowing your glowing blade to at last pierce Nabriales's essence." | #224 |
| M224i | Nabriales means to use the staff's power to bring about a new Rejoining. | *An Uninvited Ascian* · 2.5 · main | "the Ascian reveals his plans to use the power yet hidden within the staff to bring about a new [[Rejoining]]" | #224 |

| M224k | Nabriales reaches the Rising Stones' solar, where Minfilia holds the broken Tupsimati. | *An Uninvited Ascian* · 2.5 · main | "You return to the Rising Stones to find Nabriales already in [[The Solar|the solar]] with Minfilia, the Antecedent clutching the shards of the broken Tupsimati." | #224 |
| M224l | Louisoix was branded a pariah in his own land. | *An Uninvited Ascian* · 2.5 · main | "Yet this great soul, whom all should rightly have honored, was branded a pariah in his own land." | #224 |
| M225a | Moenbryda was a native of Sharlayan, so the Scions gather at the mark of the Scholar. | *In Memory of Moenbryda* · 2.5 · main | "As Moenbryda was a native of Sharlayan, I feel it is only fitting that we gather before the mark of the Scholar." | #225 |
| M225b | Midgardsormr's voice calls it life for death, a fair exchange, and promises other bargains. | *In Memory of Moenbryda* · 2.5 · main | "Life for death. A fair exchange. … Other bargains will be struck." | #225 |
| M225c | Minfilia names the dead: Louisoix, Moenbryda and the Scions at the Waking Sands. | *In Memory of Moenbryda* · 2.5 · main | "The battles we have fought have taken the lives of so many. Louisoix. Moenbryda. Our fellows at the Waking Sands." | #225 |
| M225d | Minfilia calls you her pillar of strength. | *In Memory of Moenbryda* · 2.5 · main | "You are ''my'' pillar of strength, and I fear I shall have need of your steadfast presence in the days to come..." | #225 |
| M226a | Minfilia is concerned for Yda after Moenbryda's death. | *Mask of Grief* · 2.55 · main | "Minfilia expresses concern over [[Yda]]'s emotional state following the loss of [[Moenbryda]]." | #226 |

| M226c | As Yda lays the flower at the mark of the Scholar, Dravanian wings darken the sky. | *Mask of Grief* · 2.55 · main | "As Yda places the moon daisy before the mark of the Scholar, the skies over Rathefrost are suddenly darkened by the passing of [[Dravanian]] wings." | #226 |

| M346b | Vidofnir's rescue of a child gave hope of peace between man and dragon. | *This War of Ours* · 3.2 · main | "Yet in adversity were we blessed with the promise of peace between man and dragon, through Vidofnir's timely rescue of an innocent child." | #346 |
| M346c | Aymeric is arranging a peace conference at Falcon's Nest, to be attended by Vidofnir. | *This War of Ours* · 3.2 · main | "he has begun making formal arrangements for a peace conference in [[Falcon's Nest]], to be attended by [[Vidofnir]]" | #346 |
| M346d | Aymeric fears Nidhogg, implacably opposed to peace, may disrupt the conference. | *This War of Ours* · 3.2 · main | "Given Nidhogg's implacable opposition to the peace, it is possible that he and his followers may attempt to disrupt proceedings" | #346 |
| M346e | Lucia was sent to Ishgard as a foreign spy. | *This War of Ours* · 3.2 · main | "Dispatched to a foreign nation as a spy, it was her duty to infiltrate [[Ishgard]]ian society for her masters' ends." | #346 |
| M346f | Lucia chose instead to pledge herself to Ishgard's cause and war. | *This War of Ours* · 3.2 · main | "In the end, however, she chose a different path—to pledge herself to another nation's cause, and to join in their war." | #346 |
| M346g | A relief at Falcon's Nest will be unveiled during the conference. | *This War of Ours* · 3.2 · main | "It conceals a relief that will be unveiled during the conference." | #346 |

| M347b | Lucia rides out with Artoirel, since a lord of House Fortemps will make the Convictors reluctant to oppose her. | *Staunch Conviction* · 3.2 · main | "They should be far more reluctant to oppose us were a lord of House Fortemps present." | #347 |
| M347c | Artoirel asks you to look after Emmanellain. | *Staunch Conviction* · 3.2 · main | "I must ask: would you look after Emmanellain while I am away?" | #347 |
| M347d | Artoirel calls Emmanellain impulsive and lately melancholy. | *Staunch Conviction* · 3.2 · main | "he has ever been an impulsive, changeable child, but recently he seems to have been suffering from a bout of melancholy." | #347 |
| M347e | Lords Artoirel and Emmanellain have volunteered at Falcon's Nest. | *Staunch Conviction* · 3.2 · main | "you may meet lords Artoirel and Emmanellain, who have graciously volunteered their services." | #347 |
| M348a | Emmanellain is forbidden to leave Falcon's Nest. | *Once More, a Favor* · 3.2 · main | "The wasteland beyond the walls must be kept safe for travelers, yet I have been forbidden from leaving Falcon's Nest." | #348 |
| M348b | You find Thancred, who saved two heretics from wolves. | *Once More, a Favor* · 3.2 · main | "You find Thancred, as well as two heretics he seemingly saved from a ravenous wolf pack." | #348 |
| M348c | Thancred says the young lord took advantage of you both. | *Once More, a Favor* · 3.2 · main | "The young lord wasted no time taking advantage of you, did he? And me, I suppose." | #348 |
| M349a | A waitress drugs you in the tavern. | *For Those We Have Lost* · 3.2 · main | "You crumple to the ground, and as all fades to black, you hear her whisper to sleep, to sleep..." | #349 |

| M349c | The knight shoots her, and a second arrow fells her. | *For Those We Have Lost* · 3.2 · main | "As the crowd looks on, the knight shoots, striking her in the arm. … before a second arrow silences her, and she falls from sight." | #349 |
| M349d | The knight says he did as Emmanellain ordered. | *For Those We Have Lost* · 3.2 · main | "I-I only did as you ordered, my lord..." | #349 |
| M349e | The peace conference has no chance in this climate. | *For Those We Have Lost* · 3.2 · main | "the peace conference clearly has no chance of success in this climate." | #349 |
| M349f | The people will remember a young lordling ordering an unarmed protester's execution. | *For Those We Have Lost* · 3.2 · main | "the people will not soon forget the image of a young lordling ordering the public execution of an unarmed protestor" | #349 |
| M350a | The Convictory incident was likely a ruse, and the protest leader yet lives. | *Consequences* · 3.2 · main | "They reveal that the incident at the [[The Convictory|Convictory]] was more than likely a ruse intended to draw them away from the hamlet, and that the protest leader, while gravely wounded, yet lives." | #350 |
| M350b | The protesters infiltrated Falcon's Nest as servants and guests. | *Consequences* · 3.2 · main | "She and her conspirators infiltrated Falcon's Nest posing as servants and guests." | #350 |

| M350e | Thancred strikes Emmanellain. | *Consequences* · 3.2 · main | "Thancred, in turn, deals Lord Emmanellain a swingeing blow, snarling that he knows nothing of him and his failures." | #350 |
| M350f | Thancred has tried everything to save those dear to him, and failed. | *Consequences* · 3.2 · main | "I have fought tooth and nail for the people I hold dear—done ''everything'' in my power to save them...and I have failed." | #350 |
| M350g | Lucia suspends the peace conference pending Aymeric's decision. | *Consequences* · 3.2 · main | "I have no choice but to suspend the peace conference, pending Ser Amyeric's final decision." | #350 |
| M350h | Artoirel has detained the Convictors for questioning. | *Consequences* · 3.2 · main | "Accordingly, we have detained them for questioning." | #350 |
| M350i | Lucia is the first commander. | *Consequences* · 3.2 · main | "Recalling that Lord [[Artoirel]] and the [[Lucia|first commander]] should have returned by now" | #350 |
| M350j | Honoroit is Emmanellain's manservant. | *Consequences* · 3.2 · main | "calling for his manservant to accompany him. [[Honoroit]], however, is nowhere to be seen." | #350 |
| M351a | The Alliance proposed joint exercises, which Aymeric would present as a grand melee. | *Choices* · 3.2 · main | "The other members of the [[The Eorzean Alliance|Eorzean Alliance]] have recently proposed joint military exercises, which Ser Aymeric believes could be presented as a" | #351 |

| M351c | Lucia, likely a Garlean citizen once, has seen such spectacles rally people to the imperial cause. | *Choices* · 3.2 · main | "Doubtless, as a [[Garlean]] citizen, she bore witness to similar spectacles intended to rally the people to the imperial cause" | #351 |
| M351d | Inspired by Aymeric, Emmanellain begs leave to fight in the melee. | *Choices* · 3.2 · main | "So inspired, he begs leave to participate in the grand melee" | #351 |
| M351e | Aymeric's father trusted only himself. | *Choices* · 3.2 · main | "He did not believe the people strong enough to bring about their own deliverance, trusting only in himself." | #351 |
| M351f | People call Aymeric a patricide in the streets. | *Choices* · 3.2 · main | "They decry you as a patricide in the streets." | #351 |
| M351g | You agree to fight for Ishgard. | *Choices* · 3.2 · main | "you agree to fight for Ishgard, and a jubilant Ser Aymeric declares that you shall give the people a spectacle for the ages." | #351 |
| M351h | Thancred recalls that the Ascians sought to profit from the war. | *Choices* · 3.2 · main | "In any event, let us not forget that the Ascians sought to profit from this war." | #351 |
| M352a | The grand melee is held in central Coerthas, outside the city. | *A Spectacle for the Ages* · 3.2 · main | "Lucia informs you that the grand melee is to be held in [[Coerthas Central Highlands|central Coerthas]], just outside the city." | #352 |
| M352b | General Raubahn swept aside all comers and challenged you to single combat. | *A Spectacle for the Ages* · 3.2 · main | "General of the [[Immortal Flames]], the Bull of Ala Mhigo himself, swept aside all comers and challenged you to single combat." | #352 |

| M352d | You bear House Fortemps's colors into battle. | *A Spectacle for the Ages* · 3.2 · main | "we believe the men would find it inspiring if you bore the colors of House Fortemps into battle." | #352 |
| M352e | The melee is opened in the Eorzean Alliance's name. | *A Spectacle for the Ages* · 3.2 · main | "Brave men and women of the Eorzean Alliance. Let the grand melee begin!" | #352 |
| M353a | Honoroit, Emmanellain's manservant, has fully recovered. | *For Those We Can Yet Save* · 3.2 · main | "[[Honoroit]], Lord [[Emmanellain]]'s manservant, has made a full recovery and is eager to resume his duties." | #353 |

| M354e | Nidhogg cries for vengeance, and his kin raise the final chorus. | *Causes and Costs* · 3.2 · main | "For in those twilight hours did Nidhogg cry out for vengeance, and his brethern raise their voices for the final chorus of the Dragonsong war." | #354 |

| M355b | Alphinaud thinks removing Nidhogg's eyes from the armor could free Estinien. | *The Man Within* · 3.3 · main | "Alphinaud speculates that removing the great wyrm's [[Eyes of Nidhogg|eyes]] from the dragoon's armor could potentially free him." | #355 |

| M357b | Aymeric admits his father corrupted himself with a primal's power, and he asked you to slay him. | *Winning Over the Wyrm* · 3.3 · main | "When my father corrupted himself and his followers with the power of a primal, I beseeched the Warrior of Light to slay him" | #357 |

| M357d | Only when Midgardsormr appears does Hraesvelgr agree to test you. | *Winning Over the Wyrm* · 3.3 · main | "it is not until [[Midgardsormr]] himself appears that Hraesvelgr finally assents to test you and your companions' resolve." | #357 |

| M360c | Estinien lays down the mantle of Azure Dragoon, his hunt at an end. | *Litany of Peace* · 3.3 · main | "Lord Commander, my hunt is at an end. I would lay down the mantle of Azure Dragoon." | #360 |

| M360f | Estinien has disappeared, and Aymeric asks you to carry him a message. | *Litany of Peace* · 3.3 · main | "He then reveals that Estinien has disappeared, and asks that you give him a message should your paths ever chance to cross." | #360 |

| M361a | Aymeric, newly lord speaker of the House of Lords, invites you to dine at his estate. | *Promises Kept* · 3.4 · main | "fresh from his appointment as lord speaker of the House of Lords, has extended to you a formal invitation to dine with him at his estate." | #361 |

| M361d | Thancred, tracking the Warriors of Darkness, found Alisaie on their trail too. | *Promises Kept* · 3.4 · main | "Thancred explains that after tracking the [[Warriors of Darkness]] for some time, he discovered that she too had attempted to learn more of the enigmatic adventurers." | #361 |
| M361e | Alisaie, struck by a poisoned arrow, is near death. | *Promises Kept* · 3.4 · main | "Struck by a poisoned arrow as they fled, Alisaie now teeters on the brink of death" | #361 |

| M361g | The Warriors of Darkness conspire with the Ascians to goad the Ixal into summoning. | *Promises Kept* · 3.4 · main | "The Warriors of Darkness are conspiring with the [[Ascians]] to goad the [[Ixal]] into summoning their patron deity" | #361 |

| M379g | Yda is not Yda: she is Lyse, the fallen Archon's younger sister. | *The Far Edge of Fate* · 3.56 · main | "revealing at last that she is not Yda at all, but the fallen [[Archon]]'s younger sister, [[Lyse]]." | 3.56 |
| M379h | Her real name is Lyse. | *The Far Edge of Fate* · 3.56 · main | "I'm sorry for lying to you. My real name is Lyse." | 3.56 |
| M379i | Yda died six years ago smuggling refugees out of Ala Mhigo. | *The Far Edge of Fate* · 3.56 · main | "Yda died six years ago, on a mission to smuggle refugees out of Ala Mhigo." | 3.56 |
| M379j | Papalymo brought Lyse Yda's mask as a keepsake, and she chose to take up her sister's work. | *The Far Edge of Fate* · 3.56 · main | "When Papalymo brought me Yda's mask, it was meant as a keepsake. But I decided I wanted to be his new partner; to keep alive all the good that she had done." | 3.56 |
| M379k | Papalymo persuaded the others to keep up the charade. | *The Far Edge of Fate* · 3.56 · main | "'Twas Papalymo who persuaded us to maintain the charade." | 3.56 |
| M379l | Lyse will continue her family's fight for Ala Mhigo. | *The Far Edge of Fate* · 3.56 · main | "...And I choose to continue my family's fight." | 3.56 |
| M379m | Their father fought to overthrow the mad king Theodoric. | *The Far Edge of Fate* · 3.56 · main | "He had fought to overthrow the mad king, Theodoric." | 3.56 |
| M379n | The Wall has fallen to the Alliance, as an officer reports to the Viceroy. | *The Far Edge of Fate* · 3.56 · main | "My lord Viceroy—our scouts have confirmed the preliminary reports. Baelsar's Wall has fallen to the Eorzean Alliance." | 3.56 |
| M379o | The Viceroy, Zenos, has heard the Domans call the primal Shinryu, and expects interesting days. | *The Far Edge of Fate* · 3.56 · main | "My spies tell me the Domans call it" | 3.56 |
| M379p | Zenos expects the coming days to be most interesting. | *The Far Edge of Fate* · 3.56 · main | "Yes...the coming days promise to be most interesting." | 3.56 |
| M380a | After Ilberd's assault on the Wall and his summoning of the primal now called Shinryu, the Alliance had little choice but to occupy Castrum Oriens. | *Beyond the Great Wall* · 4.0 · main | "[[Ilberd]]'s assault on [[Baelsar's Wall]] and subsequent summoning of the primal now known as “[[Shinryu]]” left the [[Eorzean Alliance]] with little choice but to occupy [[Castrum Oriens]]" | #380 |
| M380b | Raubahn asks the Scions to secure the Ala Mhigan Resistance's support. | *Beyond the Great Wall* · 4.0 · main | "General [[Raubahn Aldynn]] has asked that [[the Scions of the Seventh Dawn]] secure the support of the [[Ala Mhigan Resistance]]" | #380 |
| M380c | Lyse leads the Scions to Ala Mhigo, given her ties to the Resistance. | *Beyond the Great Wall* · 4.0 · main | "with [[Lyse]] to lead the way, given her ties to the Resistance." | #380 |

| M380e | Raubahn will not proceed without the Ala Mhigan people's support, and makes the Scions his emissaries to the Resistance. | *Beyond the Great Wall* · 4.0 · main | "As stated in my message, the Alliance will not proceed without the support and cooperation of the Ala Mhigan people. We would have you serve as our emissaries and make contact with the Resistance." | #380 |
| M380f | Cid reports that the search for Omega and Shinryu has found nothing. | *Beyond the Great Wall* · 4.0 · main | "apprises you of the latest developments in the search for [[Omega]] and Shinryu: namely, that there have not been any, the fate and whereabouts of both remaining unknown." | #380 |
| M380g | Raubahn fears Omega fell in occupied territory and may be in imperial hands. | *Beyond the Great Wall* · 4.0 · main | "Then 'tis like Omega fell to earth in occupied territory...meaning it may already be in imperial hands." | #380 |

| M380i | Raubahn expects Garlemald to answer the primal summoned on its doorstep. | *Beyond the Great Wall* · 4.0 · main | "Ilberd summoned a primal right on their doorstep—and Garlemald is not like to let such shows of defiance go unanswered." | #380 |
| M380j | Y'shtola goes with the Scions as a healer. | *Beyond the Great Wall* · 4.0 · main | "I too shall accompany you. Such endeavors are seldom hampered by a surfeit of healers." | #380 |
| M380k | Urianger stays as caretaker of the Waking Sands, watching for primals and Ascians. | *Beyond the Great Wall* · 4.0 · main | "Gladly shall I continue to serve as caretaker of the Waking Sands, and there keep watch for signs of primal and Ascian activity both." | #380 |
| M380l | Seeing Yugiri and Gosetsu off, Lyse says it is time she went home too. | *Beyond the Great Wall* · 4.0 · main | "I know how you feel. It's time I went home too..." | #380 |
| M380m | Thancred stays behind as well. | *Beyond the Great Wall* · 4.0 · main | "there are some troubles that may prove too much for a single Scion—on account of which, I mean to stay." | #380 |
| M380n | Cid says the Ironworks engaged Omega's stasis systems. | *Beyond the Great Wall* · 4.0 · main | "Even so, it bears repeating that we engaged the stasis systems." | #380 |
| M380o | Cid's people have followed the trail of destruction of Omega and Shinryu without result. | *Beyond the Great Wall* · 4.0 · main | "Omega and—Shinryu, I think the shinobi called it? Anyway, we've been studying their trail of destruction, hoping it might lead us somewhere—which it has singularly failed to do." | #380 |
| M380p | Gosetsu says the Domans' purpose and the Scions' are one, though their battlefields lie far apart. | *Beyond the Great Wall* · 4.0 · main | "Though our battlefields be a thousand malms apart, our purpose is one!" | #380 |
| M380q | Yugiri thanks the Scions for standing with her people from the first, when they came as refugees. | *Beyond the Great Wall* · 4.0 · main | "You and yours stood with us from the first, when we came to this land as refugees in search of sanctuary." | #380 |
| M380r | Yugiri's people have a new home and no longer need her; she and Gosetsu return to their master. | *Beyond the Great Wall* · 4.0 · main | "They have built a new home for themselves, and lo longer need me to shepherd them. | M381a | Lyse takes the Scions to the most influential faction of the Resistance. | *Lyse Takes the Lead* · 4.0 · main | "there are plenty of factions in the Resistance, so I'm taking us to see the one with the most influence." | #381 |
| M381b | That faction's headquarters is Rhalgr's Reach, an old temple east across the Velodyna River. | *Lyse Takes the Lead* · 4.0 · main | "Their headquarters are located in a place called Rhalgr's Reach—an old temple, to the east of here, across the Velodyna River." | #381 |
| M381c | The imperials fortified the old bridge over the Velodyna as Castellum Velodyna. | *Lyse Takes the Lead* · 4.0 · main | "It's part of Castellum Velodyna. That's what the imperials decided to call the old bridge after they fortified it." | #381 |
| M381d | A glamour hides the way into Rhalgr's Reach. | *Lyse Takes the Lead* · 4.0 · main | "So you say, but all I see are rocks. … ...Indeed. A glamour." | #381 |
| M381e | Lyse's friend, the messenger who came to the Scions, belongs to this faction. | *Lyse Takes the Lead* · 4.0 · main | "my friend Naago, the messenger who came to the Rising Stones, is a member of this faction." | #381 |
| M381f | The Resistance in the Reach was waiting for the Scions. | *Lyse Takes the Lead* · 4.0 · main | "They were waiting for us there. Men and women whose souls still cried out for what was lost." | #381 |
| M382a | Conrad commands the Ala Mhigan Resistance in Rhalgr's Reach. | *The Promise of a New Beginning* · 4.0 · main | "[[Conrad Kemp]], the commander of the [[Ala Mhigan Resistance]] in [[Rhalgr's Reach]]" | #382 |
| M382b | Alphinaud thanks Conrad for sheltering Lyse and Papalymo at great risk. | *The Promise of a New Beginning* · 4.0 · main | "pray allow me to thank you for sheltering Yda—forgive me—Lyse and Papalymo at great risk to yourselves." | #382 |
| M382c | Lyse says Papalymo laid down his life to give them a chance at a better future. | *The Promise of a New Beginning* · 4.0 · main | "Papalymo laid down his life to save us—to give us a chance to make a better future for ourselves." | #382 |
| M382d | Ilberd led Resistance fighters to the Wall and sacrificed them for his ritual. | *The Promise of a New Beginning* · 4.0 · main | "Followed him all the way to the Wall. Good men and women who never came back. … how the bastard had made sacrifices of them for his twisted ritual" | #382 |
| M382e | Alphinaud formally offers the Resistance the Alliance's military assistance. | *The Promise of a New Beginning* · 4.0 · main | "On behalf of the Eorzean Alliance, we do hereby extend a formal offer of military assistance to the Ala Mhigan Resistance." | #382 |
| M382f | Conrad sees the offer as the Alliance fighting the Empire by proxy with the Resistance's weaker forces. | *The Promise of a New Beginning* · 4.0 · main | "The Alliance, hoping to avoid a direct confrontation with the superior forces of the Empire, wishes to engage them by proxy with our vastly inferior ones?" | #382 |

| M382h | Conrad notes Lyse is not the first to fight the Empire under a false name. | *The Promise of a New Beginning* · 4.0 · main | "You're not the first person to take up arms against the Empire under a false name." | #382 |

| M385bb | Risen to a position of responsibility, Meffrid must find recruits, and goes to Ala Gannha, Lyse's birthplace. | *A Familiar Face Forgotten* · 4.0 · main | "Having subsequently risen to a position of responsibility, he has been tasked with finding new recruits, and wishes to pay a visit to the village of [[Ala Gannha]]—[[Lyse]]'s birthplace." | #385b |
| M385bc | A temple on the way was razed by the mad king Theodoric, not the Garleans. | *A Familiar Face Forgotten* · 4.0 · main | "was razed not by the [[Garlean Empire|Garleans]] but by the mad king, [[King Theodoric|Theodoric]], in the chaos that preceded the imperial invasion." | #385b |

| M386d | A shipment of prototype magitek armor has reportedly reached Castellum Velodyna from research facilities near the capital. | *Signed, Sealed, to Be Delivered* · 4.0 · main | "Namely, the arrival of a shipment rumored to have come from the research and development facilities near the capital, containing prototype magitek armor." | #386 |

| M387bb | Her father died before she limped home. | *Hard Country* · 4.0 · main | "And by the time I limped back to the hut, it was too late for my father." | #387b |
| M387bc | The imperials have made it known she is not to be helped. | *Hard Country* · 4.0 · main | "The imperials, they....they've made it known I'm not to be helped." | #387b |
| M387bd | Griseldis had gone out with her spear to gather herbs for her dying father. | *Hard Country* · 4.0 · main | "My father, gods rest his soul, was deathly sick at the time, and so I'd gone out into the forest, spear in hand, to gather herbs." | #387b |
| M387c | Grynewaht's weapon is destroyed; he flees, and the Alliance and Resistance celebrate. | *Best Served with Cold Steel* · 4.0 · main | "As the smoldering wreck of his beloved weapon belches smoke into the sky, the imperial officer flees, leaving the combined force of [[Eorzean Alliance|Alliance]] regulars and [[Ala Mhigan Resistance|Resistance]] fighters to celebrate a momentous victory." | #387 |
| M387ca | The sacks hold saltpeter for making firesand. | *Death by a Thousand Rocks* · 4.0 · main | "It's saltpeter for making firesand, in case you're curious what it's all for." | #387c |
| M387cb | The quarry brothers sell it to sutlers who trade with the Resistance. | *Death by a Thousand Rocks* · 4.0 · main | "sweeping bits and pieces off to the side, to bundle up and sell to the sutlers what trade with the Resistance." | #387c |

| M387cd | It is a living and a way of fighting back. | *Death by a Thousand Rocks* · 4.0 · main | "It's a living, and a way of fighting back besides." | #387c |
| M387d | Raubahn tells Grynewaht to run and tell his viceroy that the day belongs to Ala Mhigo. | *Best Served with Cold Steel* · 4.0 · main | "Run and tell your viceroy! The day belongs to Ala Mhigo!" | #387 |

| M540k | Cid thinks Gaius should have had the sense to stay dead after the Praetorium. | *A Brief Reprieve* · 4.56 · main | "After his humbling at the Praetorium, one would think he'd have the good sense to stay dead." | #540 |
| M541a | The Emperor has retreated to Garlemald. | *A Requiem for Heroes* · 4.56 · main | "our latest intelligence suggests the Emperor has retreated back to Garlemald." | 4.56 |
| M541b | Imperials led by a man who appears to be Zenos break through the Alliance's defenses. | *A Requiem for Heroes* · 4.56 · main | "imperial soldiers have broken through the Alliance's defenses, being led by a man who appears to be Lord Zenos." | 4.56 |
| M541c | Over the fallen stands Zenos, or the Ascian who wears his face. | *A Requiem for Heroes* · 4.56 · main | "Towering over them is Lord Zenos, or the Ascian who wears his face." | 4.56 |
| M541d | A voice tells you it has found you. | *A Requiem for Heroes* · 4.56 · main | "At last, I've found you." | 4.56 |
| M541e | The figure bids you go to the Crystal Tower, where it left something near the base. | *A Requiem for Heroes* · 4.56 · main | "Go to the Crystal Tower. I have left something for you near its base." | 4.56 |
| M541f | The figure says that, win or lose, your path leads only to oblivion. | *A Requiem for Heroes* · 4.56 · main | "Win or lose, the path you walk leads only to oblivion." | 4.56 |
| M541g | Zenos says only your death will restore the balance. | *A Requiem for Heroes* · 4.56 · main | "Equilibrium must be restored... And only your death will redress the balance." | 4.56 |
| M541h | Estinien snatched you to safety as the Ascian struck. | *A Requiem for Heroes* · 4.56 · main | "He explains that, just as the Ascian was about to strike, Estinien intervened and whisked you away to safety." | 4.56 |
| M541i | Zenos retreated soon after your rescue. | *A Requiem for Heroes* · 4.56 · main | "Though Zenos bested all before him, the battle clearly took its toll, for he retreated shortly after your rescue." | 4.56 |
| M541j | Varis left the front because of a rumor that a demon possesses his son. | *A Requiem for Heroes* · 4.56 · main | "How could I remain there while the rumor that my son is possessed by a demon spreads like a sickness here at home?" | 4.56 |
| M541k | Zenos asks Varis where his grandsire is. | *A Requiem for Heroes* · 4.56 · main | "Where is your grandsire? I would have words with him." | 4.56 |
| M541l | Tataru tells you to find the others and bring them home. | *A Requiem for Heroes* · 4.56 · main | "Go and find the others. Bring them home." | 4.56 |
| M541m | Tataru thinks the figure's may be the voice the Scions heard. | *A Requiem for Heroes* · 4.56 · main | "If his is the voice you've all been hearing, perhaps the others are with him." | 4.56 |
| M541n | Engineers stand ready to make Black Rose on Varis's order. | *A Requiem for Heroes* · 4.56 · main | "We stand ready to begin production of Black Rose, upon your order." | 4.56 |
| M541o | Tataru names the five you will need: Thancred, Y'shtola, Urianger, Alphinaud and Alisaie. | *A Requiem for Heroes* · 4.56 · main | "Thancred, Y'shtola, Urianger, Alphinaud, Alisaie... You're going to need all of them on your side to defeat him." | 4.56 |
| M541p | You find Lyse and Yugiri down and Hien unable to rise. | *A Requiem for Heroes* · 4.56 · main | "You arrive on the battlefield to find Lyse and Yugiri motionless on the ground, Lord Hien struggling and failing to get on his feet." | 4.56 |
| M541q | Your foe's blade comes down on you. | *A Requiem for Heroes* · 4.56 · main | "Your foe standing over you, the world goes dark as his blade comes crashing down on you." | 4.56 |
| M541r | You wonder whether the hooded figure was a dream. | *A Requiem for Heroes* · 4.56 · main | "Was the hooded figure a dream?" | 4.56 |
| M542a | A hidden path has opened the hollows at the foot of the Crystal Tower to the search for the beacon. | *The Syrcus Trench* · 5.0 · main | "Apparently, our colleagues have stumbled across a hidden path leading down into the hollows around the base of the Crystal Tower." | #542 |
| M542b | Tataru means to wake the sleeping Scions before the Empire comes calling again. | *The Syrcus Trench* · 5.0 · main | "We have to find a way to wake them up─and ''before'' the Empire comes calling again!" | #542 |
| M542c | Biggs and Wedge join the search because the Scions asked for aid. | *The Syrcus Trench* · 5.0 · main | "Aye, aye, well we could hardly say no to a call for aid from the Scions." | #542 |
| M542d | When you find the beacon, the mysterious voice calls to you clearly and carries you to a distant land. | *The Syrcus Trench* · 5.0 · main | "Having stumbled rather fortuitously on what turns out to be the beacon, you are subject to yet another visitation by the mysterious voice. This time, however, it rings triumphantly clear. Moments later, you find yourself transported to a distant and unfamiliar land." | #542 |
| M542e | Tataru bids you find your friends and bring them home. | *The Syrcus Trench* · 5.0 · main | "Safe journey, Warrior of Light. Find our friends, and bring them home!" | #542 |
| M542f | A peddler sends you to the Crystarium, the largest settlement for malms around. | *The Syrcus Trench* · 5.0 · main | "'Tis the biggest settlement for malms around. … They'll take good care of you in the Crystarium." | #542 |
| M542g | The guard at the Crystarium's gate bars you for refusing to say where you are from. | *The Syrcus Trench* · 5.0 · main | "But instead you chose concealment, and I will not suffer you to pass..." | #542 |
| M542h | A hooded man declares you his guest, and the guard captain calls him her lord. | *The Syrcus Trench* · 5.0 · main | "she is interrupted by the arrival of a hooded man who smoothly declares you to be his guest. … Quite all right, my lord." | #542 |
| M542i | The hooded man thanks you for answering his summons. | *The Syrcus Trench* · 5.0 · main | "let me first thank you for answering my summons." | #542 |
| M542j | He bears the title of Crystal Exarch, as caretaker of the Crystarium. | *The Syrcus Trench* · 5.0 · main | "Having been awarded the rather grandiose title of “Crystal Exarch,” I─in my capacity as caretaker of the Crystarium─thought to seek the aid of you and your companions." | #542 |
| M542k | This world is the First, one of the thirteen shards, though its people hardly know it. | *The Syrcus Trench* · 5.0 · main | "The realm in which you now find yourself belongs to one of the thirteen reflections or shards─the First, to be precise─even if its inhabitants are largely oblivious to the fact." | #542 |
| M542l | A century ago a luminous flood swallowed more than nine-tenths of the First. | *The Syrcus Trench* · 5.0 · main | "A luminous flood swallowing everything in its path. More than nine-tenths of this star was lost." | #542 |
| M542m | The survivors are hounded by abominations called sin eaters. | *The Syrcus Trench* · 5.0 · main | "And the fortunate few who survived are hounded by abominations born of that catastrophe even now. … we call them. The creature you saw earlier was one such monstrosity." | #542 |
| M542n | The Exarch learned to bridge worlds to summon the greatest of heroes, taking the Source's champion to save both worlds. | *The Syrcus Trench* · 5.0 · main | "It was to save the First from this menace that I learned to bridge the rift between worlds─that I might call upon the aid of the greatest of heroes. … Though it meant depriving a world of its champion, I had to try─for in saving the First, you would bring salvation to the Source as well." | #542 |
| M542o | No dark night has fallen there in over a hundred years. | *The Syrcus Trench* · 5.0 · main | "Over a hundred bleedin' years ago, that's when!" | #542 |
| M542p | The guard is the Crystarium's gatekeeper. | *The Syrcus Trench* · 5.0 · main | "This is the threshold of the Crystarium, stranger, and I am its gatekeeper." | #542 |
| M543a | The Exarch sends you to the Crystarium's civic leaders to learn of the world and its plight. | *City of the First* · 5.0 · main | "To that end, I would like you to visit a few of the Crystarium's civic leaders, and glean something of this world and its predicament." | #543 |
| M543b | The First's people know nothing of other stars. | *City of the First* · 5.0 · main | "the people of this world are unaware of the existence of other stars, and will struggle to accept the truth of your origin." | #543 |
| M543c | They say the Exarch's magicks pulled the Crystal Tower out of thin air. | *City of the First* · 5.0 · main | "They say his grand magicks summoned the Crystal Tower into existence─pulled the entire thing out of thin air." | #543 |
| M543d | The eldest swear the Exarch looks just as he did decades ago. | *City of the First* · 5.0 · main | "yet the eldest among us swear the Exarch looks exactly the same as he did back then..." | #543 |
| M543e | A century ago, villains called the Warriors of Light slew the Shadowkeeper, the steward of Darkness. | *City of the First* · 5.0 · main | "A hundred years ago─or near enough not to matter─villains known as the Warriors of Light slew the Shadowkeeper, the steward of Darkness." | #543 |
| M543f | Light then poured into the world until a great wave swept it: the Flood of Light. | *City of the First* · 5.0 · main | "It pooled and swelled without cease, until the day an enormous, blinding wave rose up and swept across our star. … We called this calamity the “Flood of Light.”" | #543 |
| M543g | The Oracle of Light stayed the Flood, sparing Norvrandt alone. | *City of the First* · 5.0 · main | "The Oracle of Light. She stood 'twixt us and approaching doom, and by her power did she stay the Flood. Thus was Norvrandt, and Norvrandt alone, spared the fate of erasure." | #543 |
| M543h | The sin eaters are Light incarnate, and stole the night from Norvrandt's sky. | *City of the First* · 5.0 · main | "These “sin eaters” were Light incarnate, and their fulgent presence stole the night from Norvrandt's sky." | #543 |
| M543i | The Crystal Tower is the one from the Source, moved whole to the First. | *City of the First* · 5.0 · main | "The structure is, in fact, the selfsame one you know from the Source, transported to the First in its entirety." | #543 |
| M543j | The Exarch does not know which era he took the tower from, but its arrival set fate in motion. | *City of the First* · 5.0 · main | "And although I do not know which era I tore it from, I ''do'' know that its arrival served to set the wheels of fate in motion." | #543 |
| M544a | Your fellow Scions are in the First. | *Travelers of Norvrandt* · 5.0 · main | "To put it simply, they are here in the First..." | #544 |
| M544b | Time in the First runs at a different, unpredictable pace from the Source. | *Travelers of Norvrandt* · 5.0 · main | "In the space of a single hour in your home world, an entire year might pass in the First─and the reverse could also be true." | #544 |
| M544c | Y'shtola and Urianger have spent three winters in the First, Thancred five. | *Travelers of Norvrandt* · 5.0 · main | "Y'shtola and Urianger have dwelled here for three winters all told, while Thancred's count stands at five." | #544 |
| M544d | Alphinaud and Alisaie have lived in the First for almost a year. | *Travelers of Norvrandt* · 5.0 · main | "Even our more “recent” arrivals, Alphinaud and Alisaie, have lived in the First for almost a year." | #544 |
| M544e | The Scions there are only spirits that can be seen and touched. | *Travelers of Norvrandt* · 5.0 · main | "Though they may appear to possess corporeal bodies, they are, in truth, merely spirits that one can see and touch." | #544 |

| M544g | Urianger foresaw the First rejoined with the Source, bringing the Eighth Umbral Calamity. | *Travelers of Norvrandt* · 5.0 · main | "In his vision of tomorrow, the First was rejoined with the Source... … This collision of worlds brought about the Eighth Umbral Calamity, and the deaths of countless multitudes." | #544 |

| M544i | The Scions established that eliminating the sin eaters will prevent the calamity. | *Travelers of Norvrandt* · 5.0 · main | "it was they who finally established that the elimination of the sin eaters will indeed serve to prevent the calamity." | #544 |

| M544n | After their defeat, Minfilia heard their pleas and returned their souls to the First. | *Travelers of Norvrandt* · 5.0 · main | "I remember our audience with Minfilia─how she listened to our pleas, and returned our souls to the First." | #544 |
| M544o | Minfilia and Ardbert's friends gave all they had left to hold back the Flood, and faded. | *Travelers of Norvrandt* · 5.0 · main | "Minfilia and my friends, they...they surrendered what little they had left to hold it back. Just faded away...leaving me to bear witness." | #544 |

| M544q | Ardbert thinks the world beyond saving. | *Travelers of Norvrandt* · 5.0 · main | "A waste of time. This world is beyond saving─like those who try to save it." | #544 |

| M544s | Urianger is in the faerie kingdom of Il Mheg, to the north. | *Travelers of Norvrandt* · 5.0 · main | "To the north is the faerie kingdom of Il Mheg. That is where you will find Urianger." | #544 |

| M566d | Eulmore fears the power she holds over the sin eaters. | *The Crystarium's Resolve* · 5.0 · main | "They fear the power she holds over the sin eaters, and doubtless intend to imprison her once more." | #566 |
