| M568g | Solus, watching from afar, wonders how the Exarch brought the hero of the Source to the First. | *The Oracle of Light* · 5.0 · main | "''Solus zos Galvus observes from afar.'' … How did the so-called Crystal Exarch bring the hero of the Source to the First?" | #568 |

| M568m | Minfilia ran toward a presence she felt: someone she was meant to meet, you. | *The Oracle of Light* · 5.0 · main | "You. The hero from another world. … I was asleep when I felt it. A presence. Someone I was meant to meet." | #568 |

| M569b | Minfilia has been told of the Scions' situation. | *Il Mheg, the Faerie Kingdom* · 5.0 · main | "Oh, and I should mention that Minfilia has been informed of our situation." | #569 |
| M569c | With looking grass, the hidden pixies are found out. | *Il Mheg, the Faerie Kingdom* · 5.0 · main | "Nooo, we are found! How did this mortal know our trick!?" | #569 |

| M569e | The pixies will let you see Urianger only once you have solved their troubles. | *Il Mheg, the Faerie Kingdom* · 5.0 · main | "Once you've helped solve all of our troubles, we'll let you see Urianger." | #569 |

| M570b | A mortal city called Voeburt stood there until the sin eaters came. | *Sul Uin's Request* · 5.0 · main | "There used to be a city of mortals here. A great big, bustling place called Voeburt or Boevurt or some such. … But the sin eaters came and everyone disappeared." | #570 |
| M570ba | Pixies take nothing as seriously as having fun. | *Ys Iala's Errand* · 5.0 · main | "If there's one thing we pixies are serious about, it's having fun!" | #570b |
| M570bb | Pixies hate sin eaters, which are dull and painful. | *Ys Iala's Errand* · 5.0 · main | "Sin eaters are dull and painful both, so we hate them especially!" | #570b |
| M570bc | A hungry pixie sends you to shake fruit from two belltrees. | *Ys Iala's Errand* · 5.0 · main | "Just outside the village, you'll find a hillock. Two great belltrees grow there." | #570b |
| M570c | The pixies once lived in a lush forest that the light swallowed. | *Sul Uin's Request* · 5.0 · main | "We used to live deep in a lush forest. It was beautiful beyond compare, but almost all of it was swallowed up by the light." | #570 |
| M570ca | The Fuath live in the lake and play rough. | *Oul Sigun's Plea* · 5.0 · main | "Oh, but be warned: the Fuath make their home in the lake. They tend to play rough, so have care!" | #570c |
| M570cb | The faeries' leafmen were mortals; they tried to enchant you too, but it did not catch. | *Oul Sigun's Plea* · 5.0 · main | "You and yours would've been our children too, but the enchantment didn't catch as well as we'd hoped." | #570c |
| M570cc | You water the leafmen, the faeries' children. | *Oul Sigun's Plea* · 5.0 · main | "You've given water to our children? Thank you ever so much!" | #570c |
| M570d | A pixie has you sow everbloom seeds around the village. | *Sul Uin's Request* · 5.0 · main | "So, here are some everbloom seeds. Take them and sow them here, there, and everywhere around the village." | #570 |
| M573a | The pixies will never be satisfied enough to let you go. | *Unto the Truth* · 5.0 · main | "After being subjected to a host of menial tasks and pranks, you and your comrades conclude that the pixies will never be satisfied and let you leave." | #573 |
| M573b | Pixies are believed to be born from the souls of those who died as children. | *Unto the Truth* · 5.0 · main | "They're born from the souls of those who died as children, or so it's believed." | #573 |

| M573f | In Urianger's vision, the Garleans facing defeat turn to Black Rose. | *Unto the Truth* · 5.0 · main | "Faced with defeat, the Garleans turned to a weapon most vile─Black Rose." | #573 |
| M573g | The gas wreaks carnage across Eorzea and the Empire alike. | *Unto the Truth* · 5.0 · main | "Once released, the gas took on a life of its own, wreaking untold carnage not only in Eorzea, but in the provinces of the Empire besides." | #573 |
| M573h | The weapon spares no one, not even you. | *Unto the Truth* · 5.0 · main | "For the weapon spared not one. Not even thee." | #573 |

| M573l | Il Mheg's Lightwarden is almost surely in Lyhe Ghiah, the castle in the lake, and the pixies' aid is needed to enter. | *Unto the Truth* · 5.0 · main | "'Tis all but certainly ensconced within Lyhe Ghiah, the castle which standeth in the midst of the lake. … To enter said stronghold, we must needs turn to the pixies for aid." | #573 |

| M574c | Thancred cannot manipulate aether, his body being left in the Source. | *Courting Cooperation* · 5.0 · main | "Though my body remained behind in the Source, its limitations saw fit to accompany me. Which is to say, I cannot manipulate aether." | #574 |

| M574f | At the edge of the Empty, the Minfilia of old awoke within the girl. | *Courting Cooperation* · 5.0 · main | "To the edge of the Empty, where the Flood was halted. … 'Twas there that she awakened. The Minfilia of old. My Minfilia..." | #574 |

| M574i | Should the girl choose to master her own destiny, the Oracle will bequeath her all. | *Courting Cooperation* · 5.0 · main | "But should she wish instead to become the master of her own destiny... … Then shall I bequeath to her my all." | #574 |

| M579b | Eulmore held the girl captive so she would not fight as earlier Minfilias had. | *The Lawless Ones* · 5.0 · main | "But that had all changed by the time I was found. They held me captive so that I wouldn't follow in the others' footsteps." | #579 |

| M579d | She believes Thancred keeps her close only as a contingency, because she is not his Minfilia. | *The Lawless Ones* · 5.0 · main | "I realized then that it was the only reason he kept me close─as a contingency. … Because I'm not her. I'm not his Minfilia." | #579 |
| M579e | At Nabaath Areng, something spoke through her that was not her. | *The Lawless Ones* · 5.0 · main | "I have a vague feeling that I said something to him. Only it wasn't me at all. It was ''her''." | #579 |
| M579f | She sought you out because she knew the other Minfilia wanted it. | *The Lawless Ones* · 5.0 · main | "She should be the one to live on. That's why I tried to find you─because I ''knew'' that was what she wanted." | #579 |
| M579g | She is unsure what she was meant to do once she found you. | *The Lawless Ones* · 5.0 · main | "But now that you're here...I'm not entirely sure what it was she intended me to do." | #579 |
| M579h | Titania's voice cries from the castle, demanding why they were imprisoned and begging you to play. | *The Lawless Ones* · 5.0 · main | "Why? Why did you imprison us? … Come. Come and play with us..." | #579 |

| M579j | A being that becomes a sin eater ordinarily loses everything that defined its mind. | *The Lawless Ones* · 5.0 · main | "Ordinarily, when a living being turns into a sin eater, it loses everything about its mind that defined it." | #579 |
| M580a | The Nu Mou, unable to deal with their fallen monarch, entrust you with the stone scepter. | *The Elder's Answer* · 5.0 · main | "Acknowledging that they do not have the power to deal with their fallen monarch, the Nu Mou have decided to entrust the relic to you." | #580 |
| M580b | Titania is a title, not a name, given to the one chosen to lead the pixies. | *The Elder's Answer* · 5.0 · main | "Know that Titania is not a name, but a title bestowed upon one chosen to lead the pixies by the grace of nature." | #580 |

| M580e | Seto thinks facing the faerie king is folly and refuses you the crystal shoes. | *The Elder's Answer* · 5.0 · main | "Though Seto receives you warmly, he believes that facing the faerie king is folly, and refuses to give you the crystal shoes." | #580 |

| M581c | Seto will consider giving you the relic if you prove yourself against sin eaters. | *A Resounding Roar* · 5.0 · main | "Sin eaters have been prowling the area of late. Prove yourself against them, and I will consider giving you the relic." | #581 |

| M743h | The Loporrits take the Scions for children. | *A Harey Situation* · 6.0 · main | "A group comprised entirely of children? What must their parents be thinking?" | #743 |

| M743j | Livingway would abandon Etheirys to its fate. | *A Harey Situation* · 6.0 · main | "So, sadly, there's nothing to be done but to abandon said carrot—Etheirys, in case the metaphor is lost on you—to its grisly fate." | #743 |
